name: text-anchored
title: Anchored text
summary: One word drawn at nine anchor points with every panX/panY combination of -1, 0 and 1; red guide lines cross at each anchor.
prompt: In a canvas, draw the same word at nine anchor points with every panX/panY combination, with guide lines through the anchors, to show how drawTextAnchored aligns text.
teaches: Place canvas text relative to a point with drawTextAnchored(x, y, panX, panY)
Use panX -1 / 0 / 1 to put the text to the right of, centred on, or to the left of x
Use panY -1 / 0 / 1 to put the text above, centred on, or below y
Set the text's size and colour on the paint (textSize, color, style fill) before drawing

snippets.note: panX -1, panY -1: the anchor is the text's bottom-left corner
panX 0, panY 0: the text is centred on the anchor
panX 1, panY 1: the anchor is the text's top-right corner
paint for text: color, style fill, textSize 18

check.describe: Red guide lines cross at the nine anchors. The centre word is centred on its crossing; the top-left word sits above and to the right of its crossing, the bottom-right word below and to the left, and so on for each of the nine. Resized (200×300, 450×240) the guide lines stay at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of the width and height and every word stays anchored on its crossing.

pitfalls: panX -1 puts the anchor on the text's LEFT edge (the text extends right), and panY -1 puts it on the BOTTOM edge (the text extends up): the pan says where the text goes, not where the anchor sits on it
panX and panY are required; json2rc refuses a drawTextAnchored without them, so write 0, 0 for centred text
Canvas text takes its size from the paint's textSize, and the paint is sticky: after a stroke paint, set style fill again or the text is drawn as outlines
Guide lines and anchors written as literal coordinates (50, 150, 250) only line up at the header size: derive them once from componentWidth() / componentHeight() as named variables and reuse them
